//: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 — Records of Processing Activities (ROPA) TEMPLATE. GDPR Art. 30 / LGPD Art. 37. NOT LEGAL ADVICE. This is a fill-in template the controller (the employer) completes and maintains; Postern Labs is at most a processor. Bracketed [ ] fields are for the controller/DPO to complete. Validate as JSON with self-check.mjs.

controller.name: [Employer legal name]
controller.dpo: [DPO name & contact — required where Art. 37 / LGPD Art. 41 applies]
controller.representative: [EU/BR representative if controller is outside the region]

processor.name: Postern Labs (software provider) — role depends on deployment; self-hosted = no processor role
processor.note: In self-hosted/on-prem mode Postern Labs operates no server and processes no personal data.

processingActivities.lawfulBasis: [legitimate interest — document the balancing test] (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f) / LGPD Art. 7 IX)
processingActivities.recipients: Message recipients within the org; the operator processes ciphertext + metadata only
processingActivities.retention: See retention-policy.json (content-ciphertext 365d, metadata 90d — controller to confirm)
processingActivities.crossBorderTransfer: [none | mechanism under GDPR Art. 44-49 / LGPD Art. 33-36]
processingActivities.securityMeasures: End-to-end encryption of content; TLS in transit; tamper-evident admin-audit trail

processingActivities.purpose: Provision and manage employee accounts & org directory
processingActivities.lawfulBasis: [contract / legal obligation] (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b/c) / LGPD Art. 7 V/II)
processingActivities.retention: Duration of employment relationship (+ any legal-obligation override — document it)
processingActivities.securityMeasures: Access-controlled admin console; disclosed audit trail

processingActivities.purpose: Record admin actions for accountability & employee transparency
processingActivities.lawfulBasis: [legal obligation / legitimate interest] (GDPR Art. 6(1)(c/f) / LGPD Art. 7 II/IX)
processingActivities.recipients: Affected employees (visible to them) and org admins
processingActivities.securityMeasures: Append-only, SHA-256 hash-chained, tamper-evident, NO covert/content events

dsarProcess.intake: Documented request → identity verification → rights-engine.mjs routing
dsarProcess.responseWindows: LGPD Art. 19: 15 days (full). GDPR Art. 12(3): 1 month (+2 if complex).
dsarProcess.honestLimit: Employer-served requests cannot produce/rectify E2EE content; the subject self-serves that from their own client.

reviewGate: This ROPA and the whole deployment require legal review + a real data-protection audit BEFORE production. Adherence-by-design is not certified compliance.
